metadata.name: WISE BPIC'19 Full-Log Norm
metadata.purpose: Single end-to-end WISE norm for BPIC'19 Q3 analysis from stakeholder expectations to norm, case scoring, and PI backlogs.
metadata.note: Paper-aligned version: constraint types match Section IV-B vocabulary (pres, lag, bal, sing, excl). Balance constraints added per Table V pattern.

L1_closure_completeness.name: Expected completion and closure
L1_closure_completeness.question: Which cases remain incomplete or unresolved relative to the expected flow?
L1_closure_completeness.explanation: Captures missing commercial or settlement milestones. This layer is the main bridge from raw event data to stand-out backlogs.

L2_flow_discipline.name: Flow-conditioned control discipline
L2_flow_discipline.question: Does the observed control path fit the intended process type?
L2_flow_discipline.explanation: Separates DF1, DF2, 2-way match, and consignment. This is the layer for process-type-specific normative expectations.

L3_timeliness_ageing.name: Handovers and ageing
L3_timeliness_ageing.question: Where are the main handover delays and ageing effects?
L3_timeliness_ageing.explanation: Measures the delay severity of key handovers without double-counting missing milestones.

L4_rework_instability.name: Rework and instability
L4_rework_instability.question: Which cases show repeated loops, fragmentation, or handling churn?
L4_rework_instability.explanation: Captures repeated changes, repeated receipts, and other unstable execution patterns.

L5_exceptions_corrections.name: Exceptions and corrections
L5_exceptions_corrections.question: Where do rare but important correction paths and exception events occur?
L5_exceptions_corrections.explanation: Captures cancellations, deletions, debit memos, and other explicit corrective events.

L6_value_commercial.name: Value and commercial integrity
L6_value_commercial.question: Where do invoice-correction and commercial-adjustment signals concentrate?
L6_value_commercial.explanation: Uses the available BPIC'19 proxies for wrong invoices and commercial inconsistencies.

L7_effort_automation.name: Effort and automation friction
L7_effort_automation.question: Where is execution manual, fragmented, and hard to automate?
L7_effort_automation.explanation: Captures manual touches, many human handoffs, and long event chains.

Finance.why: Finance prioritises unresolved items, ageing, and commercially relevant correction signals. Exposure-weighted PI is especially meaningful for this view.

Logistics.why: Logistics emphasises correct 2-way/3-way flow behaviour, operational handovers, and receipt/rework instability.

Compliance.why: Compliance focuses on the correct control path per process type and on explicit exception or correction events.

Automation.why: Automation emphasises change loops, manual handling, many handoffs, and complex event chains that block touchless processing.

key_principles: The same constraint catalogue is used for all views.
Views differ only through layer weights, not through changed definitions.
Lag constraints are only scored when both boundary events exist; missing milestones are handled in the closure layer to avoid double counting.
Layer scores are weighted averages over applicable constraints within the layer.
View scores are 1 minus the weighted average layer penalty over applicable layers.

pi.finance_sensitivity: Also compute exposure-weighted PI using exposure_abs_sum_million as the volume term.

constraints.description: Invoice evidence should exist for invoice-bearing flows.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: DF1, DF2, and 2-way match cases are expected to contain invoice evidence.

constraints.description: Invoice-bearing flows should eventually be cleared.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: DF1, DF2, and 2-way match cases should contain a Clear Invoice event.

constraints.description: 3-way flows should contain goods or service receipt evidence.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: DF1 and DF2 cases should contain a Goods Receipt or Service Entry Sheet.

constraints.description: In DF1, invoice evidence should not precede the first goods/service event.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: 3-way match, invoice after GR should respect goods/service before invoice.

constraints.description: In DF2, payment-block release should happen after the first goods/service event.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: 3-way match, invoice before GR should show release only after receipt evidence.

constraints.description: 2-way match should not show goods/service receipt postings.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: 2-way match does not require GR/SES and their presence is a control-path deviation.

constraints.description: Consignment should normally not be settled through standard Clear Invoice in this log scope.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Consignment cases are usually outside standard IR/CI settlement in BPIC'19.

constraints.description: In DF1, invoice should follow goods/service within a target time.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: The GR/SES to invoice handover should be timely for invoice-after-GR flows.

constraints.description: Invoice-bearing flows should clear in a reasonable time.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Invoice to Clear Invoice should not age excessively.

constraints.description: In DF2, goods/service to Remove Payment Block should be timely.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: The DF2 control release after receipt should not be delayed.

constraints.description: In DF2, released items should clear quickly.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Remove Payment Block to Clear Invoice should not create downstream backlog.

constraints.description: Too many goods/service receipt events indicate fragmentation.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Operational handling should not require excessive repeated GR/SES postings.

constraints.description: Approval changes should be rare.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Purchase-order approval should not be repeatedly re-opened.

constraints.description: Repeated invoice receipt events indicate invoice handling churn.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: A case should not require repeated invoice receipt postings.

constraints.description: Repeated payment-term changes indicate unstable commercial handling.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Payment terms should not be repeatedly changed during execution.

constraints.description: Invoice receipt cancellations should be exceptional.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Cancel Invoice Receipt indicates correction-heavy handling.

constraints.description: Goods receipt cancellations should be exceptional.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Cancel Goods Receipt indicates correction or reversal of physical receipt.

constraints.description: PO item deletion should be exceptional once execution is underway.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Delete Purchase Order Item is treated as an explicit exception signal.

constraints.description: Vendor debit memos should be rare.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Vendor creates debit memo is a strong correction signal.

constraints.description: Vendor credit memos should be rare.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Vendor creates credit memo is a strong correction signal.

constraints.description: Price changes after ordering indicate commercial inconsistency risk.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Cases should not require repeated price changes.

constraints.description: Quantity changes after ordering indicate commercial inconsistency risk.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Cases should not require repeated quantity changes.

constraints.description: Correction documents on high-exposure cases matter more financially.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Debit/Credit memo events on high-exposure cases are financially more critical.

constraints.description: Price changes on high-exposure cases are financially more critical.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Commercial corrections should be prioritised more strongly when exposure is high.

constraints.description: Too many manual touches reduce touchless processing potential.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: A case with many manual events is hard to automate.

constraints.description: Too many human handoffs indicate coordination cost.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: Cases should not require many different human resources.

constraints.description: Very long event chains indicate execution friction.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: A high event count per PO item is a practical automation barrier.

constraints.description: High manual share indicates low straight-through processing.
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: The share of human-handled events should remain moderate.

constraints.description: Large swings in cumulative net worth across events indicate commercial inconsistency (paper: balance constraint pattern, Table V c3/c4).
constraints.stakeholder_expectation: The cumulative net worth should remain stable across the case lifecycle; large fluctuations suggest corrections or mismatches.

document_type_flow.description: Document type × flow type cohorts (BPIC'19: Standard PO, Framework Order, EC Purchase Order)
